Had better, ought to and might want to for what is advisable.
You can use had better, ought to and might want to to talk about something that is advisable to do.

To create a statement using had better you need to include a verb in its base form. You use it to express strong suggestions or orders.

Use this structure to make affirmative sentences:

Subject + had better + verb + complement

Example:

You had better check these tips before you create the design.

When you create a statement using ought to, you are giving advice.

Use the following structure to make affirmative statements:

Subject + ought to + verb + complement

Example:

You ought to include search engines in the website.

When you create a statement using might want to, you are indicating what is advisable to do.

Structure

Subject + might want to + verb + complement

Example:

You might want to include colors to catch visitors’ attention.
You'd better choose a template that contains the desired style for your website.
You ought to include videos and images.
At the end, you might want to include search engines so your viewers can get information as fast as possible.
Tips to create a good web design.
Sometimes you run out of ideas for creating your websites, in the following text you will find some useful tips to create them.

A good web design should include…

 

Remember that a good website must attract viewers and empower your business. Every item you include is important; fonts, colors, images, videos and other features affect your website either in a positive or negative way.

 

The first item to take into account is the logo; your design should include a nice logo that catches the viewers’ attention. Another important feature in the design is navigation, it must be intuitive; visitors should have a smooth transition when navigating the website, it has to be totally user-friendly.

 

Don’t overload your page with unnecessary images or videos. The use of colors needs to be appropriate for the public you are aiming for. You must use colors according to color theory, in that way you will be using them strategically.

 

Finally, take into account information, you need to use appropriate fonts and size, so your information is readable. Bottoms have to be usable and visible. The most important aspect is to test the design; in that way, you are going to notice all of the things that you need to improve or change.

images.text: If you are planning to create a website, you'd better read carefully these useful tips for its design. Sometimes, you don't have clear ideas about the colors you are going to include or the fonts you are going to use, the images you need to implement or the ones you shouldn't. All of these features will determine whether your web design is a complete success or a failure. In the next paragraphs, you will find the main tips and their importance.

One of the key elements in designing web pages is to strategize the product; you need to know what the target market is, what competitors do, what your style is going to be like and what materials you will present on the web. Approaching the design is the next step; you'd better choose a template that contains the desired style for your website, you need to customize it according to your needs and likes: you ought to include videos and images.
The most important feature to take into account for any website is usability; you'd better have a web page which is user friendly, also, you ought to make sure that the navigation flow is clear enough for the visitors to use. At the end, you might want to include search engines so your viewers can get information as fast as possible, this will determine future users' traffic in the website.
Remember, these web design tips are important because they will determine the effectiveness of it attracting the viewer as well as creating a powerful website that will give a boost to your business.

contents.content: Now, it's time to advise other designers!

Write a paragraph of no more than 150 words where you give an important tip to create a good web design and describe why it is important. Read the following instructions to do so:
  1. Choose a topic for your paragraph, which could be an aspect of web design that you consider very important.
  2. Write a topic sentence. Topic sentences give direction to a paragraph; check an idea you want to explore.
  3. Write at least two supporting ideas, in order to validate what you said in the topic sentence. You can describe why you consider that tip is important, or how it will improve the rest of the design process.
  4. Write a concluding sentence. In here, you will close your paragraph summarizing and reaffirming the information of the topic sentence.
Remember to use might want to, ought to, and had better to give advice. You might want to use vocabulary like strategize, approach the design, prioritize usability, search engines, etc.
When you have typed in ALL your answers, click the Go to Writing Task button.
Well done! Now, let's review your paragraph. Keep the following recommendations in mind whenever you are writing a paragraph:

• You can use more than two supporting ideas.
  • It is not necessary to start your paragraph with the topic sentence.
  • Avoid repeating words, so your paragraph will not be redundant.
  • Check your paragraph in order to avoid spelling and grammar mistakes.
Click the submit button to save your work.
